name: Abell 2667 (Hubble)
blurb: Abell 2667, a massive galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: abell2667-hubble
story: A dense crowd of galaxies whose combined gravity bends the light of a more distant galaxy behind its core. That background galaxy is stretched into a giant arc, giving a rare look at a faraway spiral.

claims.text: The cluster's gravity lenses a more distant galaxy behind its core into a giant arc
Abell 2667 is a lensing cluster with a giant arc; the lensed galaxy is a spiral
Program 16670 is a survey of massive (extreme) galaxy clusters and includes A2667
